quotes.title: HD 168746
quotes.card: HD 168746 is a Sun-like star with a close orbiting exoplanet in the constellation of Serpens.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 7.95, it is too faint to be viewed with the naked eye but is easily visible with binoculars or a small telescope.
